limitations: Independent AI review is not native-language, human or food-safety professional certification.
Source figure/table label text was inspected. This review does not claim independent visual verification of every original PDF image, layout or every app illustration.

Some source-table microfacts (pork vitamin B1, all species/season mappings, precise colour effects of vinegar/baking soda) are more explicit in cited PDF than in the lesson paragraphs. This is a teaching-coverage refinement, not an incorrect answer key.
Equipment-list application questions combine source labels with independently authored lesson safety procedures; picture-only PDF pages alone do not prove all application rationale.
Some distractors are conspicuously implausible. Correctness accepted does not certify optimal distractor difficulty or balanced cognitive demand.

Repeated knowledge targets across weekly reinforcement and practice are intentional; cosmetic duplicates within practice identified above were replaced. Semantic review is bounded and cannot prove absolute absence of every possible overlap.
